<style>

        font-family: "Inter";
        font-style: normal;
        font-weight: 100 900;
        font-display: optional;
        src: url(/assets/fonts/inter-roman.woff2?v=OecsB5TBLy27FKD2) format("woff2");
        unicode-range: U+0000-00FF, U+0131, U+0152-0153, U+02BB-02BC, U+02C6, U+02DA, U+02DC, U+0304, U+0308, U+0329, U+2000-206F, U+2074, U+20AC, U+2122, U+2191, U+2193, U+2212, U+2215, U+FEFF, U+FFFD;

    <link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="/assets/built/screen.css?v=JW6FMERxReVfvN7u">

    <style>
        :root {
            --background-color: #ffffff;
        }
    </style>

    <style>
        /* Prevent horizontal scrolling without breaking sticky sidebar */
        html {
            overflow-x: clip !important;
            overflow-y: visible !important;
            max-width: 100vw !important;
        }
        body {
            overflow: visible !important;
            max-width: 100vw !important;
        }
        .gh-viewport {
            overflow: visible !important;
            padding-top: 0 !important;
        }
        /* Announcement bar: below nav in stacking order so dropdowns show over it */
        .gh-announcement-bar {
            position: relative !important;
            z-index: 100 !important;
        }
        /* Announcement bar contrast fix: force #c04510 on links/text (4.76:1 on #fafafa, WCAG AA pass).
           Overrides any color set via Ghost Admin → Settings → Design → Announcement bar. */
        .gh-announcement-bar,
        .gh-announcement-bar *:not(.gh-announcement-bar-close):not(svg):not(path),
        .gh-announcement-bar a,
        .gh-announcement-bar a:hover,
        .gh-announcement-bar a:visited,
        .announcement-bar,
        .announcement-bar a,
        [class*="announcement"] a {
            color: #c04510 !important;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: #c04510 !important;
        }
        /* Bold links so the darker orange still reads as a clickable CTA */
        .gh-announcement-bar a,
        .announcement-bar a,
        [class*="announcement"] a {
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            text-decoration: underline !important;
            text-underline-offset: 2px !important;
        }
        /* Navigation: must be higher than announcement bar so dropdowns aren't clipped */
        .gh-navigation {
            position: sticky !important;
            top: 0;
            width: 100%;
            z-index: 100000 !important;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease, height 0.3s ease !important;
        }
        /* Permanent single-row nav: logo on left, menu + search, ST Services + Get Featured right-aligned */
        @media (min-width: 992px) {
            .gh-navigation.is-compact {
                height: 80px !important;
                min-height: 80px !important;
                padding: 0 !important;
                overflow: visible !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-inner {
                display: grid !important;
                grid-template-columns: auto 1fr !important;
                grid-template-rows: 1fr !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                padding: 0 28px !important;
                gap: 24px !important;
                height: 80px !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-brand {
                grid-row: 1 !important;
                grid-column: 1 !important;
                min-height: unset !important;
                height: auto !important;
                display: flex !important;
                align-items: center !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-logo img {
                height: 52px !important;
                width: auto !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-menu {
                grid-row: 1 !important;
                grid-column: 2 !important;
                justify-content: flex-start !important;
                height: auto !important;
                margin: 0 !important;
                padding: 0 !important;
                width: 100% !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-menu::before,
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-menu::after {
                display: none !important;
            }
            /* Hide .gh-navigation-actions entirely on desktop — no search/members buttons in actions slot */
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .gh-navigation-actions {
                display: none !important;
            }
            /* NUKE all search-toggle buttons anywhere in the nav... */
            .gh-navigation .gh-search,
            .gh-navigation button[data-ghost-search],
            .gh-navigation button[aria-label="Search this site"],
            .gh-navigation button.search-toggle {
                display: none !important;
            }
            /* ...then show ONLY the one inside .st-nav-item--search (after Sectors) */
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search {
                display: inline-flex !important;
                align-items: center;
            }
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search .gh-search,
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search button[data-ghost-search],
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search button {
                display: inline-flex !important;
                align-items: center !important;
                padding: 8px 12px !important;
                background: transparent !important;
                border: none !important;
                cursor: pointer !important;
                color: inherit !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search svg {
                width: 22px !important;
                height: 22px !important;
                stroke-width: 2.2 !important;
                min-width: 22px !important;
                min-height: 22px !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search svg * {
                stroke-width: 2.2 !important;
            }
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search button,
            .gh-navigation .st-nav-item--search .gh-search {
                padding: 6px 10px !important;
                width: 40px !important;
                height: 40px !important;
            }
            /* Bigger nav link font — easier to read */
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .st-nav-link {
                padding: 8px 12px !important;
                font-size: 1.65rem !important;
                font-weight: 500 !important;
            }
            /* Push ST Services + Get Featured (and any items after) to the right — with a clear visual gap */
            .st-nav-list > .st-nav-item--right {
                margin-left: auto !important;
                padding-left: 48px !important;
            }
            /* Extra space after the search icon so the right-group feels detached from the left-group */
            .st-nav-list > .st-nav-item--search {
                margin-right: 12px !important;
            }
            /* Inline search icon (after Sectors) */
            .st-nav-item--search {
                display: inline-flex !important;
                align-items: center;
            }
            .st-nav-item--search .gh-search,
            .st-nav-item--search button {
                padding: 8px 10px !important;
                background: transparent !important;
                border: none !important;
                cursor: pointer !important;
                color: inherit !important;
                display: inline-flex !important;
                align-items: center !important;
            }
            .st-nav-item--search svg {
                width: 22px !important;
                height: 22px !important;
            }
            /* Get Featured — keep secondary/outlined style even on taller compact nav */
            .gh-navigation.is-compact .st-get-featured-btn {
                padding: 7px 16px !important;
                font-size: 1.5rem !important;
                font-weight: 600 !important;
            }
        }
        /* Reduce nav item gap slightly */
        .gh-navigation .nav {
            gap: 20px;
        }
        /* Services dropdown menu */
        .nav-services-dropdown > a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .nav-services-dropdown > a::after {
            content: '';
            border-left: 4px solid transparent;
            border-right: 4px solid transparent;
            border-top: 5px solid currentColor;
            margin-left: 2px;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        /* Dropdown panel: fixed to viewport, positioned by JS */
        #services-dropdown-panel {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            min-width: 220px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
            padding: 8px 0;
            z-index: 9999;
        }
        #services-dropdown-panel.is-visible {
            display: block;
        }
        #services-dropdown-panel a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            color: #333 !important;
            text-decoration: none !important;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: background 0.15s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        #services-dropdown-panel a:hover {
            background: #f5f5f5;
            color: #111 !important;
        }
        #services-dropdown-panel .service-icon {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            width: 24px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        /* Hub nav dropdown triggers (shared style for all 7 hubs) */
        .nav-hub-dropdown > a {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .nav-hub-dropdown > a::after {
            content: '';
            border-left: 4px solid transparent;
            border-right: 4px solid transparent;
            border-top: 5px solid currentColor;
            margin-left: 2px;
            transition: transform 0.2s;
        }
        /* Individual hub dropdown panel (shared style) */
        .nav-hub-panel {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            min-width: 200px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
            padding: 8px 0;
            z-index: 9999;
        }
        .nav-hub-panel.is-visible {
            display: block;
        }
        .nav-hub-panel a {
            display: block;
            padding: 9px 20px;
            color: #333 !important;
            text-decoration: none !important;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            font-weight: 500;
            transition: background 0.15s;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .nav-hub-panel a:hover {
            background: #f5f5f5;
            color: #f95913 !important;
        }

        /* Visual breadcrumb navigation */
        .st-breadcrumbs {
            padding: 10px 0 0;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-list {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 4px;
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            font-size: 1.3rem;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-link {
            color: #888 !important;
            text-decoration: none !important;
            transition: color 0.15s;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-link:hover {
            color: #f95913 !important;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-sep {
            color: #bbb;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            list-style: none;
            line-height: 1;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-current {
            color: #555;
            overflow: hidden;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            max-width: 380px;
        }
        .st-breadcrumbs-current span {
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        @media (max-width: 767px) {
            .st-breadcrumbs-current {
                max-width: 180px;
            }
        }

        /* Left column: 2 cards — first big, second compact to align bottoms */
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:first-child {
            flex: 1;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) {
            flex: 0 0 auto;
            border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            padding-top: 16px;
            margin-top: 16px;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) .gh-card-link {
            flex-direction: row;
            gap: 16px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) .gh-card-image {
            flex: 0 0 140px;
            aspect-ratio: 3/2;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) .gh-card-image img {
            border-radius: 6px;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) .gh-card-title {
            font-size: 1.6rem;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-left .gh-card:nth-child(2) .gh-card-excerpt {
            display: none;
        }
        /* Middle column: compact spacing, show all 3 article images, align with other columns */
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle {
            gap: 8px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle .gh-card:last-child .gh-card-image {
            display: block !important;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle .gh-card .gh-card-image {
            max-height: none;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle .gh-card .gh-card-image img {
            width: 100%;
            height: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle .gh-card .gh-card-link {
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-middle .gh-card .gh-card-title {
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        }
        /* Logo: prominent and at front of header */
        .gh-navigation-logo img {
            object-fit: contain !important;
            width: auto !important;
            max-height: 52px !important;
        }
        .gh-navigation-brand {
            order: -1;
        }
        /* Highlight layout: Featured posts right column */
        .gh-header.is-highlight .gh-header-right {
            grid-column: 13 / -1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0;
        }
        .gh-highlight-featured-title {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: var(--color-secondary-text);
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ghost-accent-color, #f95913);
        }
        .gh-highlight-card {
            display: flex;
            gap: 10px;
            align-items: center;
            text-decoration: none;
            color: inherit;
            padding: 10px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            transition: background 0.15s;
        }
        .gh-highlight-card:hover {
            background: var(--color-lighter-gray);
        }
        .gh-highlight-card img {
            width: 56px;
            height: 56px;
            object-fit: cover;
            border-radius: 6px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gh-highlight-card-text {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 2px;
            min-width: 0;
        }
        .gh-highlight-card-tag {
            font-size: 1rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            /* Contrast fix: #c04510 on #fafafa = 4.76:1 (WCAG AA pass); was #f95913 (3.11:1 fail) */
            color: #c04510;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.02em;
        }
        .gh-highlight-card-title {
            font-size: 1.45rem;
            font-weight: 400;
            line-height: 1.35;
            letter-spacing: -0.01em;
            display: -webkit-box;
            -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
            -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gh-highlight-card:hover .gh-highlight-card-title {
            color: var(--ghost-accent-color, #f95913);
        }
        /* Sticky article bar (post pages) — hidden above viewport by default */
        .gh-article-bar {
            position: fixed !important;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            top: -100px;
            z-index: 998 !important;
            background: #fff;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5;
            border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
            transition: top 0.25s ease, opacity 0.25s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .gh-article-bar.is-visible {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        /* Logo in sticky article bar */
        .gh-article-bar-logo {
            height: 28px;
            width: auto;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            margin-right: 4px;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-inner {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            gap: 12px;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            min-width: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-avatar {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            object-fit: cover;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-author {
            font-size: 1.3rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-sep { color: #999; }
        .gh-article-bar-date {
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            color: #888;
            white-space: nowrap;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-btn {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
            border-radius: 6px;
            background: #fff;
            color: #333;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 500;
            text-decoration: none;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s;
        }
        .gh-article-bar-btn:hover {
            background: #f5f5f5;
            border-color: #ccc;
        }
        /* "Get Featured" nav button */
        .gh-navigation .nav a.nav-cta-btn {
            background: var(--ghost-accent-color, #f95913) !important;
            color: #fff !important;
            padding: 6px 14px !important;
            border-radius: 6px !important;
            font-weight: 600 !important;
            font-size: 1.3rem !important;
            transition: opacity 0.15s !important;
        }
        .gh-navigation .nav a.nav-cta-btn:hover {
            opacity: 0.85 !important;
        }
        /* Social share icons */
        .social-share {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
        }
        .social-share a,
        .social-share button {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--color-secondary-text);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
            padding: 0;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .social-share a:hover,
        .social-share button:hover {
            background: var(--color-lighter-gray);
            color: var(--color-primary-text);
        }
        .social-share svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
        }
        /* Post page sidebar (SeizeLead only) */
        .post-main {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 360px;
            gap: 40px;
            max-width: var(--container-width, 1320px);
            margin: 0 auto;
            padding: 0 var(--container-gap, 24px);
        }
        .post-main > .gh-article { min-width: 0; grid-column: 1; }
        .post-main > .gh-inline-article { grid-column: 1; }
        .post-main .gh-canvas { max-width: none; padding: 0; }
        /* SeizeLead mobile slot: hidden on desktop (sidebar shows instead) */
        .seizelead-mobile-slot { display: none; }
        .post-main > .sidebar {
            padding-top: 40px;
            position: -webkit-sticky !important;
            position: sticky !important;
            top: 80px !important;
            align-self: start !important;
            max-height: calc(100vh - 100px);
            overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .post-main > .gh-comments { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
        /* Full-width article: add internal tag #full-width to any post to hide sidebar and widen content.
           Used for articles with wide tables, data viz, or immersive layouts. */
        /* #no-help internal tag: hides the SeizeLead "Happy to help you" form on specific articles.
           The quiz widget is allowed to remain — only the help/contact form is hidden. */
        .post-main.is-no-help [class*="help" i][class*="seizelead" i],
        .post-main.is-no-help [id*="help" i][id*="seizelead" i],
        .post-main.is-no-help [class*="happy-to-help" i],
        .post-main.is-no-help [id*="happy-to-help" i],
        .post-main.is-no-help .seizelead-widget-help,
        .post-main.is-no-help .SeizeLead-widget-help,
        .post-main.is-no-help [data-seizelead-help],
        .post-main.is-no-help [data-seizelead="help"],
        .post-main.is-no-help [data-seizelead="contact"] {
            display: none !important;
        }

        .post-main.is-full-width {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            padding: 0 max(4vmin, 20px) !important;
        }
        .post-main.is-full-width > .sidebar { display: none !important; }
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-canvas { max-width: none !important; padding: 0 !important; }
        /* Keep header and normal body text comfortable — let wide content (tables, kg-width-wide, kg-width-full) break out */
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-article-header,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > p,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > h2,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > h3,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > h4,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > ul,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > ol,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content > blockquote {
            max-width: 900px;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }
        /* Tables and wide media use the full width — this is the whole point of full-width mode */
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content table,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content .gh-table,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content .kg-card,
        .post-main.is-full-width .gh-content figure {
            max-width: 1400px;
            width: 100%;
            margin-left: auto;
            margin-right: auto;
        }
        /* Article body: slightly larger font for readability */
        .post-template .gh-content {
            font-size: 1.9rem !important;
            line-height: 1.75 !important;
        }
        .post-template .gh-content h2 { font-size: 2.8rem !important; }
        .post-template .gh-content h3 { font-size: 2.4rem !important; }
        /* Tag/Author page: 4 cards per row on desktop */
        .tag-template .gh-feed,

    var LIFTED_ATTR = 'data-st-lifted';

    function isMobile() { return window.innerWidth <= 767; }

    function isNearBottom(rect) {
        /* Fixed element whose bottom edge sits within the bottom 100px of viewport */
        var viewportBottom = window.innerHeight;
        return (viewportBottom - rect.bottom) < 100;
    }

    function shouldSkip(el) {
        /* Skip the mobile share bar itself, the navigation, and the footer */
        if (!el || el === document.body || el === document.documentElement) return true;
        if (el.classList && (
            el.classList.contains('gh-mobile-social-bar') ||
            el.classList.contains('gh-navigation') ||
            el.classList.contains('gh-footer')
        )) return true;
        /* Skip anything INSIDE the share bar, nav, or footer */
        if (el.closest && (
            el.closest('.gh-mobile-social-bar') ||
            el.closest('.gh-navigation') ||
            el.closest('.gh-footer')
        )) return true;
        return false;
    }

    function liftWidget(el) {
        if (el.hasAttribute(LIFTED_ATTR)) return;
        /* Save original bottom so we can restore on desktop resize */
        var cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
        var origBottom = cs.bottom;
        el.setAttribute(LIFTED_ATTR, origBottom || 'auto');
        el.style.setProperty('bottom',
            'calc(' + SHARE_BAR_HEIGHT + 'px + ' + (origBottom && origBottom !== 'auto' ? origBottom : '0px') + ')',
            'important'
        );
    }

    function restoreWidget(el) {
        if (!el.hasAttribute(LIFTED_ATTR)) return;
        var orig = el.getAttribute(LIFTED_ATTR);
        el.style.removeProperty('bottom');
        el.removeAttribute(LIFTED_ATTR);
    }

    function scan() {
        if (!isMobile()) {
            /* Restore all lifted widgets on desktop */
            var lifted = document.querySelectorAll('[' + LIFTED_ATTR + ']');
            for (var i = 0; i < lifted.length; i++) restoreWidget(lifted[i]);
            return;
        }
        /* Walk ALL elements in body (expensive on huge pages, but widgets are few).
           Filter to only position:fixed elements pinned near the bottom. */
        var all = document.body.getElementsByTagName('*');
        for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
            var el = all[i];
            if (shouldSkip(el)) continue;
            var cs = window.getComputedStyle(el);
            if (cs.position !== 'fixed') continue;
            var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();

        window.addEventListener('resize', scan);
        /* SeizeLead and WhatsApp floats often inject 1-3 seconds after DOMContentLoaded */

        if (window.MutationObserver) {
